# February 2021 Texas Power Crisis Analysis

## Introduction

## Load Packages

```{r}
#| output: False

library(sf)          # vector handling
library(stars)       # raster handling
library(terra)       # raster handling
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)        # map making
library(gt)          # table formatting
```

## Prepare Data

### Load Data

```{r}
# Load February 7, 2021 VIIRS data for Houston tiles
VIIRS_feb07a <- stars::read_stars('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v05.001.2021039064328.tif')
VIIRS_feb07b <- stars::read_stars('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v06.001.2021039064329.tif')
# Combine February 7, 2021 tiles
pre_storm <- st_mosaic(VIIRS_feb07a, VIIRS_feb07b)

# Load February 16, 2021 VIIRS data for Houston tiles
VIIRS_feb16a <- stars::read_stars('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v05.001.2021048091106.tif')
VIIRS_feb16b <- stars::read_stars('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v06.001.2021048091105.tif')
# Combine February 16, 2021 tiles
blackout <- st_mosaic(VIIRS_feb16a, VIIRS_feb16b)

# Load data for Houston area houses
houses <- st_read('data/gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg', query = "SELECT *
FROM gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1 
WHERE (type IS NULL AND name IS NULL) 
OR type in ('residential', 'apartments', 'house', 'static_caravan', 'detached')", quiet = TRUE)

# Load data for Texas highways
highways <- st_read('data/gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg', query = "SELECT * FROM gis_osm_roads_free_1 WHERE fclass='motorway'", quiet = TRUE)
```

### Check Coordinate Reference Systems

```{r}
# Verify that pre_storm and blackout raster CRSs match
if(st_crs(pre_storm) == st_crs(blackout)) {
  print(paste('CRS match. CRS is:', st_crs(pre_storm)))
}else{
  warning('CRS do not match')
  print(paste('pre_storm CRS is', st_crs(pre_storm)))
  print(paste('blackout CRS is', st_crs(blackout)))
}
```

```{r}
# Verify that houses and highways vector CRSs match
if(st_crs(highways) == st_crs(houses)) {
  print(paste('CRS match. CRS is:', st_crs(highways)))
}else{
  warning('CRS do not match')
  print(paste('highways CRS is', st_crs(highways)))
  print(paste('houses CRS is', st_crs(houses)))
}
```

The nighttime light data, houses data, and roads data all use the EPSG 4326 coordinate reference system.

## Visualize blackout

```{r}
# Define Houston area
houston_area <- st_bbox(c(xmin = -96.5, ymin = 29, xmax = -94.5, ymax = 30.5),
                        crs = st_crs(pre_storm))

# Crop pre storm and blackout rasters to Houston area
pre_storm_crop <- st_crop(pre_storm, houston_area)
blackout_crop <- st_crop(blackout, houston_area)

# Set unrealistic radiance values to NA (values greater than 500)
pre_storm_crop[pre_storm_crop > 500] <- NA
blackout_crop[blackout_crop > 500] <- NA

# Stack and name data layers for visualization
feb_storm_stacked <- c(pre_storm_crop, blackout_crop)
names(feb_storm_stacked) <- c("February 7, 2021 (Pre-Storm)", "February 16, 2021 (Blackout)")

```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 9
#| out-width: "100%"

# Visualize nighttime lights from February 7, 2021 and February 16, 2021
blackout_map <- tm_shape(feb_storm_stacked) +
      tm_raster(col.scale = tm_scale(values = "magma"),
                col.legend = tm_legend(title = "Light Intensity\n(nW cm⁻²sr⁻¹)",
                                       title.size = 0.7,
                                       position = tm_pos_out('right'))) +
      tm_facets(as.layers = FALSE, nrow = 2, free.scales = FALSE) +
      tm_graticules(lwd = 0.25, col = "white", alpha = 0.5, labels.size = 0.4, labels.rot = c(90, 0)) +
      tm_title("Houston, Texas Nighttime Light Radiance", 
                fontface = "bold",
                position = tm_pos_out("center", "top"))

blackout_map
```

## Identify blackout areas

Identify all blackout areas in Houston:
```{r}
# Calculate difference in night light intensity pre and post storm
night_difference <- pre_storm - blackout

# Convert to SpatRaster for terra operations
night_difference <- rast(night_difference)

# Classify areas that experienced drop of more than 200 nW cm-2sr-1 (blackout)
blackout_rcl <- matrix(c(-Inf, 200, , # no blackout
                           200, Inf, 1), # experienced blackout
                           ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE) 
blackout_areas <- classify(night_difference, rcl = blackout_rcl)
blackout_areas <- st_as_stars(blackout_areas) # convert back to stars for stars operations

# Vectorize blackout mask
blackout_mask <- blackout_areas |> 
                 st_as_sf() |> 
                 st_make_valid()

# Crop blackout mask to Houston area and reproject to EPSG:3083
houston_blackout <- st_crop(blackout_mask, houston_area) |> st_transform(crs = "EPSG:3083")
```
